title: Job Openings at Credpal
content:
Credpal is an innovative solution that seeks to combat the ever complex loan approval process that has deterred millions from achieving specific goals over the years. We believe quality of life can be drastically improved if individuals can easily make purchases and pay overtime at their convenience with reduced or no financial pressure, while also increasing their purchasing capabilities.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Sales & Business Development Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time (Hybrid)

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly driven Sales & Business Development professional to lead client acquisition, investment mobilisation, and commercial growth for Widestride International Limited's investment products, particularly the WIL Balanced Asset.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for building and converting a strong pipeline of High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs), corporates, institutional investors, family offices, associations, cooperatives, and other qualified investors, while developing strategic partnerships that increase Assets Under Management (AUM), revenue, and market presence.
	The role requires a commercially minded professional with strong knowledge of financial and investment products, excellent relationship-management capabilities, and a demonstrable track record of mobilising funds and closing investment mandates.


Responsibilities


	Drive investment mobilisation into the WIL Balanced Asset and other approved investment products across equities, fixed income, FX, and other SEC-approved asset classes, while identifying attractive investment opportunities and assessing relevant market risks.
	Achieve agreed monthly, quarterly, and annual AUM, revenue, and client acquisition targets.
	Identify, prospect, engage, and convert HNIs, corporates, institutional investors, family offices, cooperatives, and other qualified investors.
	Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective investors and investment mandates.
	Build long-term relationships with existing clients to drive retention, repeat investment, referrals, and increased wallet share.
	Identify new markets, distribution channels, strategic partnerships, and opportunities for investment growth.
	Develop relationships with corporates, financial institutions, investment clubs, professional associations, and other organisations with significant investible funds.
	Present and market investment products, proposals, portfolio information, and performance reports to prospective and existing clients.
	Clearly communicate the structure, benefits, risks, and investment strategy of the WIL Balanced Asset.
	Demonstrate good understanding of Treasury Bills, bonds, money market funds, term deposits, equities, REITs, and other approved investment instruments.
	Work closely with the Treasury Portfolio Manager and Investment team to align client expectations with portfolio strategy.
	Provide market and client intelligence to support product development, pricing, positioning, and investment strategy.
	Monitor market developments, interest rates, yields, competitor products, investor behaviour, and emerging investment opportunities.
	Maintain accurate records of prospects, client engagements, investment commitments, and conversion status.
	Prepare weekly and monthly reports on investment mobilisation, AUM growth, revenue, pipeline value, conversion rates, and client acquisition.
	Develop forecasts for expected investment inflows and pipeline conversion.
	Represent Widestride at investor meetings, industry events, conferences, networking sessions, and business engagements.
	Ensure all investment sales activities comply with SEC regulations, AML/KYC requirements, internal policies, and approved marketing standards.
	Work with Compliance to ensure proper client onboarding, KYC documentation, and regulatory compliance.
	Provide regular commercial and business development updates to Executive Management.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Banking & Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; relevant postgraduate qualifications are an added advantage.
	Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in the Nigerian capital markets, investment management, securities trading, treasury, asset management, or a related financial services environment.
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian capital market operations and regulations, including SEC, NGX, FMDQ, CBN requirements, and applicable investment and trading guidelines.
	Demonstrated experience in investment research, securities analysis, trade execution, portfolio monitoring, valuation, and performance analysis across fixed income, equities, FX, or other approved asset classes.
	SEC Sponsored Individual / SEC registration or relevant professional certification such as CFA, CIS, CISI, ACT, ACA/ACCA is an added advantage.
	Excellent quantitative, financial, and qualitative analytical skills, with strong numerical ability and the capacity to interpret financial statements, market data, and economic indicators.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office tools, including financial modelling, data analysis, reporting, and presentation preparation.
	Familiarity with capital market and financial information platforms.
	We are seeking a highly driven Sales & Business Development professional to lead client acquisition, investment mobilisation, and commercial growth for Widestride International Limited's investment products, particularly the WIL Balanced Asset.


Benefits


	Competitive salary and benefits package.
	Opportunity to work with a newly established fund management company and contribute to its growth and success.
	Collaborative and dynamic work environment.
	Professional development and training opportunities.


Click here to apply online

 

 

2.) Capital Market Analyst

Job Location: Lagos
Job type: Full-time (Hybrid)

Description


	Widestride International Limited manages the WIL Balanced Asset as a discretionary private  investment product designed to deliver a balanced combination of capital growth, income generation, and risk mitigation in line with each investor’s objectives and risk profile.
	The portfolio is strategically diversified across low-risk instruments, including Treasury Bills, investment-grade bonds, money market funds, and term deposits, as well as medium-risk investments such as SEC-approved equities and publicly listed Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs). This diversified approach enables the portfolio to pursue competitive returns while maintaining prudent risk management and capital preservation.


Purpose Statement


	We are seeking a highly analytical and market-driven Capital Markets Analyst to support investment research, trade execution, portfolio monitoring, and market intelligence.
	The role will analyse investment opportunities, track portfolio performance, support capital market transactions, and provide timely insights that enable informed investment decisions, strong risk management, and improved portfolio returns.


Responsibilities


	Conduct market, company, and securities research across equities, fixed income, FX, and other SEC approved asset classes to identify investment opportunities and market risks.
	Analyse stocks and other investment instruments using financial statements, valuation models, market data, and macroeconomic indicators, and provide clear investment recommendations.
	Execute and support capital market trades in line with approved investment strategies, limits, pricing parameters, and internal controls.
	Monitor the Company’s proprietary investment portfolio, including daily positions, mark-to-market valuations, exposures, gains/losses, and performance against approved benchmarks.
	Track portfolio and trading performance, including ROI, benchmark performance, settlement efficiency, yield, and other relevant investment KPIs.
	Prepare valuation, pricing, and financial analyses for capital market transactions in accordance with applicable regulatory and internal requirements.
	Monitor market, credit, liquidity, operational, and settlement risks, and promptly escalate significant exposures or breaches.
	Support regulatory compliance and reporting relating to SEC, NGX, FMDQ, CBN, and other applicable capital market requirements and intermediaries.
	Prepare investment research reports, portfolio performance reports, market updates, and presentation materials for management and weekly investment meetings.
	Maintain effective working relationships with brokers, banks, custodians, counterparties, and internal teams, supporting trade execution, settlement, market intelligence, and investment-related enquiries.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Banking & Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; relevant postgraduate qualifications are an added advantage.
	Minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in the Nigerian capital markets, investment management, securities trading, treasury, asset management, or a related financial services environment.
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian capital market operations and regulations, including SEC, NGX, FMDQ, CBN requirements, and applicable investment and trading guidelines.
	Demonstrated experience in investment research, securities analysis, trade execution, portfolio monitoring, valuation, and performance analysis across fixed income, equities, FX, or other approved asset classes.
	SEC Sponsored Individual/SEC registration or relevant professional certification such as CFA, CIS, CISI, ACT, ACA/ACCA is an added advantage.
	Excellent quantitative, financial, and qualitative analytical skills, with strong numerical ability and the capacity to interpret financial statements, market data, and economic indicators.
	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MS Office tools, including financial modelling, data analysis, reporting, and presentation preparation.
	Familiarity with capital market and financial information platforms.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex market and financial information into clear investment recommendations, reports, and presentations.
	Strong attention to detail, initiative, commercial awareness, time management, and ability to meet deadlines, with a diligent and proactive approach to investment analysis and trade support.


Benefits


	Competitive salary and benefits package
	Opportunity to work with a newly established fund management company and contribute to its growth and success
	Collaborative and dynamic work environment
	Professional development and training opportunities


Click here to apply online

 


3.) Treasury Portfolio Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Purpose Statement


	We are seeking an experienced Senior Capital Markets, Treasury & Portfolio Management professional to lead the Company’s treasury, investment, and portfolio activities, drive portfolio growth and profitability, optimize liquidity and returns, manage SEC-approved investment products, and ensure strong regulatory compliance and risk management.


Responsibilities


	Lead the development and execution of the Company’s treasury, investment, and portfolio management strategy to drive sustainable growth, profitability, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.
	Manage the Company’s investment portfolio and SEC-approved investment products, including asset allocation, security selection, portfolio rebalancing, performance monitoring, and risk management.
	Identify, originate, evaluate, and execute investment opportunities across approved asset classes, including fixed income, equities, money market instruments, and alternative investments.
	Oversee treasury and liquidity management, including cash-flow forecasting, cash positioning, short-term investments, funding requirements, and efficient deployment of surplus funds.
	Drive portfolio and revenue growth through client acquisition, investment mobilization, and effective relationship management across high-net-worth individuals, corporates, institutional investors, and other strategic clients.
	Build and manage strategic relationships with banks, financial institutions, brokers, custodians, fund managers, institutional investors, regulators, and other capital market stakeholders.
	Develop and enhance investment products and solutions aligned with market opportunities, regulatory requirements, client needs, and the Company’s overall commercial objectives.
	Conduct market research, financial analysis, and portfolio reviews to identify emerging opportunities, assess market risks, optimize returns, and recommend timely strategic adjustments.
	Ensure full compliance with SEC regulations, investment guidelines, internal policies, risk frameworks, and industry best practices, while maintaining appropriate controls across treasury and investment activities.
	Provide strategic treasury and investment advice to Executive Management and lead the Treasury & Investment team, including preparation of investment proposals, financial forecasts, portfolio performance reports, management reports, and development of team capability as the business grows.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Banking & Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; relevant professional qualifications such as CFA, ACT, ACA/ACCA, CPA, CIS, FRM, or an MBA/Master’s degree are an added advantage.
	Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in Treasury, Capital Markets, Investment Management, Asset Management, Wealth Management, Corporate Finance, or related financial services, with demonstrated senior-level experience.
	Proven track record in managing liquidity, cash positions, funding requirements, investments, and capital market transactions within a regulated financial institution or investment environment.
	Demonstrated experience in developing and executing investment and treasury strategies, driving portfolio growth, optimizing returns, and preserving capital.
	Strong knowledge of money and capital market instruments, including Treasury Bills, Commercial Papers, Bonds, Fixed Income Securities, Mutual Funds, Equities, Repos, and other investment products.
	Strong expertise in portfolio management, including asset allocation, security selection, portfolio rebalancing, yield optimisation, performance measurement, and risk-adjusted return analysis.
	Sound understanding of treasury and investment risk management, including market, liquidity, interest-rate, credit, and counterparty risks, as well as regulatory requirements, governance, and internal controls.
	Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, with proficiency in spreadsheets, cash-flow forecasting, scenario and sensitivity analysis, investment appraisal, portfolio modelling, and relevant treasury and market tools.
	Excellent commercial judgment, business development, negotiation, leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage clients, financial institutions, regulators, and senior management.
	SEC Sponsored Individual status or relevant SEC registration is an added advantage.


Click here to apply online

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Assistant Farm Manager",
  "description": "Amo Farm Sieberer Hatchery Limited has a Vision to be the market leader in the Day Old Chicks market; through exceptional quality products and services that will guarantee profitable poultry farming.

The Company produces high-quality Day-Old Chicks and Point of Cage Pullets. Over the years, we have remained focused on our main objective to produce high quality chicks, in a highly hygienic environment leveraging innovative solutions grounded in Research and Development.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Assistant Farm Manager

Job Location: Awe, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Assistant Farm Manager will support the Farm Manager in coordinating daily farm operations, ensuring compliance with biosecurity and animal welfare standards, supervising farm personnel, and driving productivity across breeder, broiler, or layer operations.
	The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, sound technical knowledge of poultry production, and a commitment to operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities


	Assist in planning, coordinating, and supervising daily poultry farm operations.
	Ensure adherence to company biosecurity, health, safety, and animal welfare standards.
	Monitor flock performance, including mortality, feed intake, weight gain, egg production, fertility, and hatchability, as applicable.
	Supervise and support farm supervisors, attendants, and other operational staff.
	Ensure proper feeding, watering, vaccination, medication, and environmental management of birds.
	Monitor feed, medication, and farm consumables to minimise wastage and maintain accurate inventory records.
	Assist in implementing production plans and achieving set performance targets.
	Maintain accurate farm records, including production, mortality, medication, vaccination, and inventory reports.
	Identify operational challenges and recommend corrective actions to improve efficiency and productivity.
	Coordinate farm maintenance activities to ensure facilities and equipment remain in good working condition.
	Support disease prevention initiatives by ensuring strict compliance with biosecurity protocols.
	Assist with staff training, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.
	Collaborate with veterinarians, laboratory personnel, maintenance teams, and other departments to ensure seamless farm operations.
	Prepare periodic operational reports for management.


Qualifications


	Bachelor&#39;s degree or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Animal Science, Animal Production, Agriculture, Veterinary Medicine, or a related field.
	Relevant professional certifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:


	5&ndash;7years of experience in commercial poultry production.
	Practical experience in breeder, broiler, or layer farm management.
	Experience supervising farm personnel and coordinating daily production activities.
	Good understanding of poultry husbandry, biosecurity, and flock management.


Required Competencies:
Technical Competencies:


	Strong knowledge of commercial poultry production systems.
	Good understanding of poultry nutrition, vaccination, and disease prevention.
	Knowledge of farm equipment and facility management.
	Ability to analyse production data and prepare reports.
	Computer proficiency, particularly in Microsoft Office Suite.


Behavioural Competencies:


	Strong leadership and people management skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Good planning and organisational abilities.

Assistant Farm Manager Job at Amo Farm Sieberer Hatchery Limited




        
    

        
        Amo Farm Sieberer Hatchery Limited has a Vision to be the market leader in the Day Old Chicks market; through exceptional quality products and services that will guarantee profitable poultry farming.

The Company produces high-quality Day-Old Chicks and Point of Cage Pullets. Over the years, we have remained focused on our main objective to produce high quality chicks, in a highly hygienic environment leveraging innovative solutions grounded in Research and Development.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Assistant Farm Manager

Job Location: Awe, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Assistant Farm Manager will support the Farm Manager in coordinating daily farm operations, ensuring compliance with biosecurity and animal welfare standards, supervising farm personnel, and driving productivity across breeder, broiler, or layer operations.
	The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, sound technical knowledge of poultry production, and a commitment to operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities


	Assist in planning, coordinating, and supervising daily poultry farm operations.
	Ensure adherence to company biosecurity, health, safety, and animal welfare standards.
	Monitor flock performance, including mortality, feed intake, weight gain, egg production, fertility, and hatchability, as applicable.
	Supervise and support farm supervisors, attendants, and other operational staff.
	Ensure proper feeding, watering, vaccination, medication, and environmental management of birds.
	Monitor feed, medication, and farm consumables to minimise wastage and maintain accurate inventory records.
	Assist in implementing production plans and achieving set performance targets.
	Maintain accurate farm records, including production, mortality, medication, vaccination, and inventory reports.
	Identify operational challenges and recommend corrective actions to improve efficiency and productivity.
	Coordinate farm maintenance activities to ensure facilities and equipment remain in good working condition.
	Support disease prevention initiatives by ensuring strict compliance with biosecurity protocols.
	Assist with staff training, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.
	Collaborate with veterinarians, laboratory personnel, maintenance teams, and other departments to ensure seamless farm operations.
	Prepare periodic operational reports for management.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's degree or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Animal Science, Animal Production, Agriculture, Veterinary Medicine, or a related field.
	Relevant professional certifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:


	5–7years of experience in commercial poultry production.
	Practical experience in breeder, broiler, or layer farm management.
	Experience supervising farm personnel and coordinating daily production activities.
	Good understanding of poultry husbandry, biosecurity, and flock management.


Required Competencies:
Technical Competencies:


	Strong knowledge of commercial poultry production systems.
	Good understanding of poultry nutrition, vaccination, and disease prevention.
	Knowledge of farm equipment and facility management.
	Ability to analyse production data and prepare reports.
	Computer proficiency, particularly in Microsoft Office Suite.


Behavioural Competencies:


	Strong leadership and people management skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Good planning and organisational abilities.
	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Close attention to detail and commitment to quality.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet production targets.
	Integrity, accountability, and a proactive approach to work.


Method of Application
